mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases equity discount rates, compressing valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This effect is consistent across monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS against 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the direction of the relationship reverses (positive returns when FEDFUNDS is high).

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightening below 3.5% unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals potential inflation, leading to Federal Reserve rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and high consumer spending (RSAFS above 12-month MA) signal an overheating economy, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression of 20-day returns on UNRATE, RSAFS, and their interaction, or the negative returns occur in less than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two months), rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, leading to further rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO against 60-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the returns are negative in more than 60% of high INDPRO periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1500 thousand units (HOUST > 1500) signal strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1500, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS above 5.0% and fall in UNRATE below 3.8% signals aggressive monetary tightening in a tight labor market, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term in a regression of 20-day returns on FEDFUNDS, UNRATE, and their product is not significant (p>0.05), or the negative returns occur in less than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (GDP growth > 2% and UNRATE < 4.0%), rising consumer spending (RSAFS) signals excessive demand, prompting Federal Reserve rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
